combo_label: Things That Beep × Deserts × Ghosts & Hauntings

entries.clue: Speech with the breath left in and the voice taken out.
Missing what a hat would sit on, like Sleepy Hollow's rider.
Wall of grit driven by a gale, turning the sky brown at midday
Towering Sonoran giant with upraised arms, a century old before it branches
Keep returning to trouble a house, a road or a person.
Hole in the wall that beeps in a panic until you remember to take your card.
Sleeplike state entered before the voices are said to arrive.
Ceiling sentinel that chirps once a minute all night when it wants a fresh battery
Second-tallest bird alive, striding the dry Australian plains after water
On your toes, or the 3pm handset screech of the 23 April 2023 national test
Southerly that lifts North African dust over the sea and reddens Italian skies
Checkout gun that beeps at each barcode and judges your snack haul.
